# Example Plot

```{python}
# | label: fig-sine
# | fig-cap: "Sine wave"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 10, 200)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("sin(x)")
plt.show()
```
